payload.summary: The treasury management strategy for 2026/27. Full Council sets two lines on the council's own borrowing every year: an operational boundary, the level it works within, and an authorised limit, the legal ceiling it may not pass. For 2025/26 those are £314.409m and £344.409m; for 2026/27, £320.179m and £350.179m. Against them the strategy puts the council's own estimate of its external borrowing at £145.948m — every column of that table is headed "Estimate". The strategy also carries the council's indicator for how much of its core money comes from commercial property and lending: 4% in 2024/25, and 3% or 4% forecast every year to 2030/31.
